title: Delivered to the Wrong Address? F-35 Parts Re-routed to Hong Kong
gist: A shipment of F-35 parts bound for Australia was reportedly re-routed to Hong Kong last summer; Robert Farley argues the incident exposes a basic contradiction between the F-35's proprietary secrecy and aggressive US export and offshoring.

themes.theme: Export versus secrecy in defense tech
